Qualcomm Unveils New Snapdragon Elite Gen 6 Chipsets

Qualcomm has announced two new flagship mobile chipsets, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6. These chips are designed to enhance artificial intelligence capabilities and mobile gaming performance in upcoming smartphones, featuring a new Adreno Neural Fusion that uses AI for intelligent graphics.
